meaning.en: Simple past tense and past participle of upload.
meaning.vi: Quá khứ đơn và quá khứ phân từ tải lên.

sentences.en: Files can be uploaded directly into the system, and an easy search option makes finding them extremely simple.

sentences.en: Make sure you return to the ' www ' folder after you have uploaded your images to update a page.
